package.name: diy_ndt_localization
package.description: [DEPRECATED 2026-09-09 — kept for reference/rollback, not launched by localization.launch.py or challenge_master.launch.py. Replaced by map_localizer (see src/map_localizer, src/diy_localization/config/ map_localizer.yaml) after a real bug was found in this package's publishTF(): it broadcast the raw scan-matched map->base_link pose directly as "map->odom" TF, with no odom->base_link lookup/composition at all (no tf2_ros::Buffer/TransformListener existed in the class despite the headers being included) -- since odom->base_link is ALSO published separately by the EKF, this would have double-applied the odom offset the moment this node was actually run (it also could never start anyway -- see the GlobalMap.pcd path issue below). See docs/reuse_plan_step1.md Step 11 for the full writeup.] NDT-OMP based map-matching localization for the DIY Robot Challenge 2026. Loads GlobalMap.pcd produced by LIO-SAM, matches each incoming Hesai lidar scan, and publishes the map->odom transform consumed by Nav2.
